capabilities: Sync vault files bi-directionally with Baidu Netdisk across desktop and mobile
Encrypt files client-side with AES-256-GCM before upload
Migrate configuration between devices via encrypted pairing codes
Resolve concurrent edit conflicts with last-write-wins logic
Sync selected plugins and themes while excluding workspace caches
extras: Setup requires registering a personal developer application on the Baidu Netdisk open platform to obtain AppKey/Secret. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. End-to-end encryption is optional. Documentation is provided in both English and Chinese.
motivation: The author built it to avoid commercial sync subscription fees and infrastructure costs (VPS, NAS, S3) and to give mobile users sync without complex Git workflows.
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync is a paid subscription, and free routes like Git are hard to use on mobile or WebDAV services can be throttled, so users need a free multi-device sync path.

relations.evidence: cross-platform bi-directional synchronization plugin for Obsidian via Baidu Netdisk

requires.name: Baidu Open Platform AppKey and AppSecret (personal developer app)

summary: Bi-directional vault synchronization via Baidu Netdisk across desktop and mobile, with optional AES-256-GCM encryption and one-click device pairing.
